audit.whatIsWrong: Five of the seven level rows contradicted their own why text and the packet chart: rows 1, 3, 4 and 6 were given to Ornn or 'Skill' while the whys describe Akshan poking Ornn off the wave, and row 1 was given to Akshan while its why says neither side can commit.
audit.why: Akshan out-ranges Ornn with Avengerang (850) and Dirty Fighting's second shot before Bellows Breath exists, and Heroic Swing (18s at rank 1) removes him from a Searing Charge commit. Ornn's win rate here comes from scaling, not lane.
audit.corrected: Whole chart proposed as one atomic group in matched full/content pairs: Skill, Akshan, Akshan, Akshan, Akshan, Akshan, Ornn — which is exactly the packet chart. Ratings adjusted with it and the full-layer whys rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5].why claimed Iceborn Gauntlet lets Ornn force fights, when the content layer says the first-item window is Akshan's.
audit.why: His first-item poke and waveclear hold Ornn back; Ornn's real spike is level 13 Masterwork upgrades and the two-item front line.
audit.corrected: phases[5].why now says the first-item window is his and Ornn only fights on a spent grapple.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never mentioned that Volcanic Rupture's magma pillar is terrain — which is both the anchor Heroic Swing can grapple and the terrain Searing Charge needs to knock up. Cooldown text gave no numbers.
audit.why: Heroic Swing fires a hook into terrain; Searing Charge only creates the shockwave knockup on colliding with terrain. The same pillar serves both, so pillar placement is the decisive call in this lane.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d now warn against handing him a free anchor and give Heroic Swing's 18s and Comeuppance's 100s; dontsFull[1].d states the terrain requirement plainly.

edits.before: Q-poke and AA-trade — your base stats are quietly elite. Identify how Akshan contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Neither of you can commit at 1 — he has Avengerang poke, you have no W and no combo, so trade farm and take CS at max range.

edits.before: W brittle turns every trade into bonus %HP damage. Only take the trade when Akshan's Heroic Swing is down.
edits.after: Avengerang and Dirty Fighting's extra shot chip you from outside your range while Bellows Breath does not exist yet.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Akshan must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Bellows Breath is online, but Heroic Swing swings him out of your Searing Charge before Brittle lands; it is 18s at rank 1.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Heroic Swing's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: His Avengerang poke chips faster than you can punish and his spacing denies the Searing Charge knockup — farm and wait for a whiffed grapple.

edits.before: Iceborn Gauntlet is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Heroic Swing's cooldown.
edits.after: His first-item poke and waveclear keep you back; take Iceborn Gauntlet and only fight on a spent grapple.

edits.before: - Akshan Heroic Swing: matchup-defining — His dash + camera swing escape. Engage when it's down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Heroic Swing: 18s at rank 1 — he needs terrain to grapple, and your Q pillar is terrain, so never hand him a free anchor. Step up in its downtime. - Comeuppance: 100s at rank 1. - Your R: kill windows only.

edits.before: His dash + camera swing escape. Engage when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Heroic Swing is 18s at rank 1 — step up in its downtime, and never Q a pillar he can grapple.

edits.before: Q the pillar behind Akshan, E-dash through it for the knockup when his answer is down, and W-brittle the trade for the proc.
edits.after: Drop the Q pillar behind Akshan, Searing Charge into it for the knockup, then Bellows Breath to Brittle and burst him down.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Searing Charge only knocks up on terrain — no wall, no knockup.

edits.before: E-dashing with no terrain in the line — no knockup means you delivered yourself to his combo for free.
edits.after: Bellows Breath applies Brittle and amplifies the follow-up — land the flame before you spend the knockup.

notes: The level chart on disk was internally consistent but contradicted both the packet chart and its own why text on five rows; the whole chart is proposed as one group so it lands together. Brittle's exact numeric effect is not in Riot's text, so nothing here quantifies it — only that Bellows Breath applies it and amplifies follow-up. Going Rogue's camouflage roam threat is real per the kit text but no vision-control advice is asserted beyond what the page already has.
